szenen.text: Wall Street's active fund managers are dumping stocks. Their exposure index fell to fifty-one, the lowest since April 2025.
Two weeks ago it was eighty-seven. That is minus forty-one percent in two weeks, the fastest drop since November 2023.
But real panic looks different. In the 2020 crash the index hit eleven. In the 2022 bear market, thirteen.
Our view: the big money is leaving fast, but this is not panic yet. We think the selling is not done.
